market_risk_exposures: Commodity price risk (crude, refined products, blending products, soybean oil) via non-designated commodity derivatives, plus interest rate risk on long-term debt. No FX, ethanol, renewable feedstock/products, NGL or natural gas exposure is discussed in this section (that fuller list is in the FY2025 10-K, which this section only cross-references).
hedging_strategies: Company does not designate any of its commodity derivative instruments as accounting hedges; it manages commodity price exposure economically, evaluating and revising its derivatives portfolio on an ongoing basis in anticipation of market/risk-profile changes, with the expectation that derivative gains/losses will be offset by opposite moves in the underlying physical commodity.
risk_assessment: Management says it remains at risk for changes in the market value of its commodity derivative instruments, but expects that risk to be mitigated by offsetting price changes in the underlying physical commodity (offset not reflected in the sensitivity table). On rates, fixed-rate debt's fair value is sensitive to rate moves, but this only hurts results/cash flow if MPC elects to repurchase or retire fixed-rate debt above carrying value; floating-rate exposure is nil since all long-term debt is fixed-rate.
